info.title: Fenergo Nebula Covenants & Conditions Query API
info.description:
**Covenants & Conditions Query API**:


Covenants & Conditions Query API provides endpoints in order to retrieve all related models and their versions.


**Covenants & Conditions Query API provides**:
  • The ability to query Covenant Condition Set per parent.
  • The ability to query Covenant Condition Set.
  • The ability to query Covenant Condition Version.

get.summary: Get a Covenant Condition Set of specified Id with all Version data
get.description:
This method returns the Covenant Condition Set of specified Id with all Covenant Condition Versions data.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: CovenantsConditionsAccess

parameters.name: setId
parameters.description: The Id of the Covenant Condition Set

parameters.name: X-TENANT-ID
parameters.description: The UiD of the tenant representing organization

200.description: Success. A Covenant Condition Set is returned

400.description: Bad request. The request has missing/invalid values

messages.message: Not Found. Covenant Condition Set with given id does not exist
